#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    // Generate prefix sums
    vector<long long> prefix_sums(51, 0);
    prefix_sums[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < 51; ++i) {
        prefix_sums[i] = prefix_sums[i - 1] + (1LL << i);
    }

    int h, n_input;
    cin >> h >> n_input;

    long long n = n_input + prefix_sums[h - 1];
    vector<long long> sequence_list;
    sequence_list.push_back(n);
    while (n > 1) {
        n /= 2;
        sequence_list.push_back(n);
    }

    int steps = 0;
    long long current_node = 1;
    bool flip_state = false;

    while (current_node != sequence_list[0]) {
        vector<long long> temp_sequence;
        long long temp_value = current_node;
        for (int i = 0; i < h; ++i) {
            temp_sequence.push_back(temp_value);
            if (!flip_state) {
                temp_value *= 2;
            } else {
                temp_value = temp_value * 2 + 1;
            }
            flip_state = !flip_state;
        }
        if (temp_value == sequence_list[0]) {
            steps += h;
            break;
        }
        temp_sequence.push_back(temp_value);
        reverse(temp_sequence.begin(), temp_sequence.end());
        for (int i = 1; i <= h; ++i) {
            if (sequence_list[i] == temp_sequence[i]) {
                steps += prefix_sums[i - 1] + h - i + 1;
                h = i - 1;
                current_node = temp_sequence[i - 1];
                if (current_node == temp_sequence[i] * 2) {
                    current_node = temp_sequence[i] * 2 + 1;
                    flip_state = false;
                } else {
                    current_node = temp_sequence[i] * 2;
                    flip_state = true;
                }
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    cout << steps << "\n";
    return 0;
}
